order_wins: **Transrail Lighting** - secures domestic T&D orders worth over **Rs 574 crore**, primarily driven by HTLS transmission-line reconductoring jobs, taking year-to-date order intake to Rs 1,609 crore _(~9.0% of mcap)_.

**Kanohar Electricals** - receives a Notification of Award from a Central Public Sector Undertaking for 400 kV power transformers over 24 months, in its Large Order band (**Rs 250 crore and above**) _(~3.7% of mcap)_.
**Highway Infrastructure** - enters into a contract agreement for user-fee collection and toll plaza operations along the Gorakhpur Link Expressway, **Rs 220.66 crore** _(~68.3% of mcap)_.

**Ceigall India** - receives a Letter of Intent from Bihar's Department of Mines and Geology for leasing stone blocks in Nawada Lot-4: Rs 28.82 crore a year rising 20% annually, **Rs 214.52 crore** over five years _(~3.2% of mcap)_.

**Interarch Building Solutions** - secures a pre-engineered steel building order for a data centre from an unnamed domestic customer, approximately **Rs 89 crore** including taxes, executable over 10 months _(~3.2% of mcap)_.

**Solarworld Energy Solutions** - secures a purchase order from a leading renewable energy player to supply 96,000 solar panels via subsidiary ZNShine Solarworld, **Rs 78.75 crore** including 5% IGST _(~7.2% of mcap)_.
**North Eastern Carrying Corporation** - bags a 2-year iron-ore transportation contract from Tata Steel from Kalamang to various railway siding locations, **Rs 78.19 crore** _(~40.6% of mcap)_.

**Almondz Global Securities** - subsidiary Almondz Global Infra Consultant receives a Letter of Award from Odisha IDCO as Programme Management Consultant for two years, **Rs 33.15 crore** excluding GST _(~9.9% of mcap)_.

**Neueon Corporation** - secures a work order from Share Medical Care Foundation for campus civil renovation works across hospital and college areas, approximately **Rs 25 crore** over six months _(~2.9% of mcap)_.
**Action Construction Equipment** - bags an order from the Border Roads Organisation, Ministry of Defence, for supply of 74 units of 4x4 backhoe loaders under Make in India; value not disclosed.
**NCC Limited** — NCC Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Inox Green Energy Services** - allots equity shares under its qualified institutions placement, raising approximately **Rs 300 crore** from institutional buyers _(~4.4% of mcap)_.
**Urban Enviro Waste Management** - board approves a rights issue of up to **Rs 70.00 crore** and clears the Draft Letter of Offer for in-principle listing approval _(~65.8% of mcap)_.

**Dhariwalcorp** — board proposed 33 lakh shares to promoters at Rs 26.14 (Rs 8.63 crore) and 1.70 crore warrants at the same price to promoter and public investors (**Rs 44.44 crore**), subject to shareholder approval.

**Pelatro** — after NSE observations, revised its proposed preferential warrant issue to 6,85,000 warrants at Rs 400 (**up to Rs 27.40 crore**) for promoters Varun and Kiran Menon and public investors including Invicto Incrementum Fund; shareholders vote by postal ballot.

**Sat Kartar Life** — board proposed 5.5 lakh convertible warrants at Rs 172 each to promoter-group allottees led by Manprit Singh Chadha, **Rs 9.46 crore**, about 18% above the floor price, subject to shareholder approval.
**Texmo Pipes and Products** — received NSE and BSE in-principle approval for its proposed preferential issue of up to **15.30 lakh equity shares** to the proposed allottees.

**Adani Enterprises** — its Rights Issue Committee approved reminder notices to holders of partly paid shares who have not paid the **Rs 450 first call** and/or **Rs 450 second and final call** on the Rs 1,800-per-share rights issue.
**Gujarat Themis Biosyn** — shareholders approved a **preferential equity issue** (size not stated in this filing) and an articles amendment letting lenders and investors appoint a board observer.
equity_allotments: **Chandan Healthcare** - allots 6,50,000 equity shares at Rs 234 on conversion of warrants issued earlier on a preferential basis (**Rs 15.21 crore**), to two non-promoter allottees including Negen Capital.

**Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals** — allots 11.5 lakh equity shares on conversion of warrants issued earlier at Rs 63.80, on receipt of the 75% balance (**Rs 5.50 crore**), to promoter and non-promoter holders.
m_and_a: **KPI Green Energy** - enters into a binding offer to acquire 100% of Alfanar Energy and Netra Wind, operating 507.9 MW of wind assets in Bhuj, Gujarat, for an enterprise value of **Rs 2,410 crore** _(~35.3% of mcap)_.

**Oriana Power** - completes the first tranche of its 74% stake sale in Truere Current (a 40 MWp solar and 20 MWh battery storage project) to Actis group's Leo Energies for **~Rs 176 crore EV** _(~5.7% of mcap)_.

**Puravankara** — completed the sale of its entire stake in Purva Ruby Properties to Prishal Office Parks III, owned by an ICICI Prudential AIF, for an estimated **Rs 145 crore**; the deal was first disclosed in June.
**Kalyan Jewellers** - sold 783.25 cents of land in Coimbatore, on which it runs no business, for **Rs 86.16 crore** by sale deed _(~0.15% of mcap)_.

**Thermax** — completed buying the remaining 49% of TSA Process Equipments, now wholly owned, for **Rs 42 crore** in tranches; seller Fabtech Technologies' filing puts its 2,23,440-share second tranche at a revised Rs 13.99 crore.

**Thirumalai Chemicals** — its fund-raising committee approved selling up to 9.5 lakh shares (3.25%) of Ultramarine & Pigments in the open market, about **Rs 39.8 crore** at the Rs 418.50 close (our arithmetic), from its 9.38% holding.

**LT Foods** — subsidiary Nature Bio Foods B.V. agreed to buy a further 40.75% of Dutch plant-based snack maker Leev.nu for **EUR 1.735 million** cash, taking control at 70.75%; Leev.nu's turnover is about EUR 6 million.
**Mukka Proteins** - reports a procedural timeline extension to 31 January 2027 for completing its 51% partnership acquisition in Aqua Marine (**Rs 15 crore**), originally announced in June 2026.
**TAC Infosec** - completes the revised acquisition of assets of Safehouse Technologies for **Rs 1.00 crore**, modified from its earlier whole-company agreement.
**Asian Energy Services** — NCLT Mumbai sanctioned on 29 September the **merger by absorption of Oilmax Energy** into the company; it will give effect to the scheme once the certified order arrives.

**Ambuja Cements** — filed the scrutinizer's report on the 29 September NCLT-convened shareholder vote on the **amalgamation of ACC into Ambuja**; the vote counts are not in the part of the filing we read.

**GSPL Transmission** — shares began trading on BSE and NSE on 30 September, completing the GSPC group merger-demerger scheme; it runs about **2,900 km** of Gujarat gas pipelines and plans 711 km more.

**Dixon Technologies** — subsidiary Dixon Electro Appliances signed an **IP licence agreement with Aviat Networks (India)** to manufacture and sell microwave radios using Aviat's know-how; value not disclosed.

**Texmaco Rail** — subsidiary Texmaco Defence Technologies agreed to buy **100% of Indolem Technologies Systems** (autonomous land and sea defence systems, set up in March 2026) for **Rs 8 lakh** cash, closing within 30 business days.

**Anupam Rasayan** — corrected its 28 September filing: partner Mates Visa Consultancy acquired **5,09,84,595 Bliss GVS Pharma shares (47.95%)** under the share purchase agreement, and Anupam itself holds 22,51,669 shares.
**Amber Enterprises** — material subsidiary IL JIN Electronics pushed the deadline for its second-tranche stake purchase in MoMagic Wireless to **30 November 2026** from 30 September.
**Senco Gold** — extended its strategic and marketing tie-up with August Jewellery (owner of the Melorra brand) **to 31 March 2027** on the same terms; no consideration involved.

**Technocraft Industries** — subsidiary Technosoft Engineering Projects **dropped its proposed purchase of 100% of Technosoft Integrated Solutions K.K.** (Japan), which never started operating; no material financial impact, per the company.

**KNR Constructions** — extended the deadline to **15 October 2026** for selling KNR Ramanattukara Infra to Indus Infra Trust as some pre-conditions are delayed; the other three road SPVs in the deal are already sold.

**Univastu India** — offered to buy the assets of **Cambium Networks Ltd (in administration)** through a planned UK subsidiary, signing exclusivity and paying a **USD 300,000 non-refundable deposit**; total consideration not stated in the text read.

**Linde India** — completed its purchase of **two 1,800 TPD air separation units** at Tata Steel's Kalinganagar Phase II site and began supplying industrial gases to Tata Steel from them; value not disclosed.
capex_core: **DCM Shriram** — commissioned a **100 TPD aluminium chloride plant** (total capacity now 250 TPD) and one **133 TPD calcium chloride line** at Jhagadia, Bharuch; the second calcium chloride line is due in October 2026.

**R&B Denims** — subsidiary Ricon Industries began commercial production of spun polyester yarn at its Surat-district unit on 30 September, after an initial outlay of about **Rs 25 crore**, integrating backwards into yarn for its denim.
**Sacheerome** — completed installing its new manufacturing plant at Sector-32, YEIDA (Uttar Pradesh) and began **trial production** there.
business_updates: **Results season** — 5 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Smartworks Coworking Spaces** - announces new managed office deals worth **~Rs 305 crore** across multiple cities with tenures up to 60 months, taking recent sign-ups to ~Rs 540 crore.

**Solarworld Energy Solutions** - releases business and financial updates highlighting FY26 revenue of Rs 1,376 crore (up 152.6% YoY) and an active order book and bidding position of **Rs 20,096.75 crore**.

**Blue Dart** — announced a general price increase of **9% to 12%** across its domestic portfolio from 1 January 2027, varying by product and customer shipping profile; customers signing up between 1 October and 31 December 2026 are exempt.

**Jindal Stainless** — supplied **over 160 tonnes** of fabricated stainless steel columns, beams and girders through Jindal Stainless Steelway to reinforce Sadhana Bhawan at Shri Kripalu Dham, Mangarh; value not disclosed.
**Coforge** — launched **CXNova**, a multi-agent AI platform for orchestrating real-time enterprise customer experiences; no commercial terms disclosed.
**Royal Orchid Hotels** — opened **Regenta, Bhadohi** in Uttar Pradesh through subsidiary Regenta Hotels; the group says it now operates 126+ hotels.
distress_risk: **Aarti Pharmalabs** - files a Writ Petition before the Gujarat High Court challenging a **Rs 59.50 crore** stamp duty and penalty order levied by the Superintendent of Stamps over its 2022 demerger.

**Auri Grow India** — NCLT Indore admitted an operational creditor's petition and put the company into **insolvency (CIRP)** from 18 September; interim resolution professional Rajesh Jasti now runs it and has invited creditors' claims.

**Debock Industries** — disclosed SEBI's final order in its matter; the directions it summarises debar noticee Naturo IndiaBull from the securities market for **two years** with a **Rs 50 lakh** penalty. Debock is examining the order.

**Lloyds Enterprises** — SEBI passed a **settlement order** disposing of its July 2025 show cause notice alleging fraudulent-trade-practice and listing-rule breaches, settled without admitting or denying; the company reports no financial impact.
**IRFC** — received a Bihar GST show cause notice for April 2022 to March 2023 for **Rs 396.91 crore** including interest and penalty; it calls the issues generic and is filing a reply.

**RBL Bank** — received a Maharashtra GST show cause notice proposing **Rs 173.09 crore** including interest and penalty for FY23 over input tax credit in its digital banking unit; it won the identical issue for FY19 and FY20.

**KNR Constructions** — received income-tax penalty orders (section 270A) for AY2017-18 to AY2020-21 totalling **Rs 91.85 crore** (our arithmetic), the largest Rs 56.40 crore for AY2019-20; it will appeal.
**Sundrop Brands** — received an Uttar Pradesh GST show cause notice for FY23 demanding **Rs 26.38 crore**, including a Rs 2.40 crore penalty; it says GST already paid was ignored and will contest.

**Le Travenues (ixigo)** — received a Karnataka GST show cause notice for FY23 proposing **Rs 23.80 crore**, alleging bus bookings should be taxed at 18% instead of 5%; a similar FY22 notice was dropped.

**MT Educare** — disclosed continuing defaults since March 2021 on loans from Prudence ARC (**Rs 16.44 crore principal, Rs 3.75 crore interest**) and Axis Bank (Rs 7.65 crore, Rs 4.51 crore); it has been in CIRP since December 2022.

**Welspun Enterprises** — received a Haryana GST show cause notice for FY23 proposing **Rs 15.37 crore** of tax plus interest and penalty over input tax credit; it calls the demand not maintainable and will reply.
**Maruti Suzuki** — Suzuki Motor Gujarat (now merged into Maruti) received an income-tax penalty order for FY23 of **Rs 14.96 crore**; the company will appeal and expects no major impact.
**Cyber Media** — received a Chennai sales-tax assessment order for FY 2001-02 demanding **Rs 97.16 lakh**; it calls the order contrary to settled law and plans a writ petition.
**Thirumalai Chemicals** — received a Ranipet GST show cause notice for AY2022-23 totalling **Rs 13.52 lakh** over exempt turnover and input tax credit; it expects an insignificant impact.
**Kirloskar Electric** — received a Karnataka GST notice (DRC-01) demanding **Rs 12.57 lakh** of tax and interest for the April 2022 to March 2023 audit period.
credit_rating_changes: **Paras Defence** — ICRA **upgraded its long-term rating to [ICRA]A from [ICRA]A-**, outlook Stable, and kept the short-term rating at [ICRA]A2+ on an increased amount.
**Punjab Chemicals & Crop Protection** — CARE **upgraded its bank-facility ratings to CARE A- / A2+ from CARE BBB+ / A2**, outlook Stable, on limits enhanced to Rs 200 crore from Rs 100 crore.

**Servotech Renewable** — Infomerics kept its long-term rating at IVR BBB+ but revised the **outlook to Positive from Stable**, with rated bank facilities raised to Rs 451.84 crore from Rs 298.86 crore.
**Chalet Hotels** — ICRA reaffirmed its [ICRA]AA- rating and **revised the outlook to Positive from Stable**; its proposed NCD limit was enhanced to Rs 500 crore from Rs 250 crore.
other_notable: **Hitech Corporation** — independent directors issued their recommendation on the promoter group's voluntary delisting offer for 25.57% held by the public: floor **Rs 252**, indicative **Rs 353** a share, bids 7–13 October.

**Avalon Technologies** — clarified that the reported block sale is by Bhaskar Srinivasan's promoter group (**15.42%** stake, including KBS Family Trust), and that Kunhamed Bicha's promoter group is not selling.
